newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Placer says has 76.5 pct of Highlands.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Placer says has 76.5 pct of Highlands.

text.p: Canada's Placer Dome Inc said on Monday it had lifted its holding in Highlands Gold Ltd to more than 76.5 percent from 58 percent on January 17, after launching a bid for Highlands in November last year.

"We are extremely pleased with the success of our offer and have received phone calls from many more shareholders who intend to accept," Placer Dome president and chief executive John Willson said in a statement.
"We are expecting to receive acceptances from those shareholders before our offer closes at the end of the week," he said.
Placer Dome's offer of 75 cents per share is scheduled to close on February 8. Highlands and Placer each own 25 percent of the giant Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea.

Highlands recommended its shareholders accept the offer in late January after Placer Dome agreed to a restructuring proposal under which Highlands would float off a seperate company, Highlands Pacific, which would hold the company's non-Porgera assets in PNG and Indonesia.
At 10.40 a.m. (2340 GMT), Highlands shares were steady at 81 cents each.
